name: Open Farm Grass-Fed Beef Recipe
description: Pasture-raised beef recipe with humanely-sourced meat, non-GMO produce, and traceable ingredients you can look up by lot number.
whyRecommended: One of the few dog food brands publishing full ingredient traceability. Every protein is third-party certified humane.
editorsNote: If you only upgrade one thing in your dog's diet, make it the protein source. Open Farm's transparency is the gold standard.

name: The Honest Kitchen Whole Grain Chicken Clusters
description: Human-grade dehydrated kibble made in a human food facility with cage-free chicken and whole grains. Just add water.
whyRecommended: Human-grade certification means the entire facility meets standards for human food — a much higher bar than typical pet food.
editorsNote: Great middle ground for owners who want fresh-quality nutrition without the freezer footprint of frozen food.

name: Stella & Chewy's Freeze-Dried Dinner Patties
description: 95% raw cage-free poultry, grass-fed beef, or wild-caught fish. Freeze-dried to lock in nutrients with no synthetic preservatives.
whyRecommended: Closest you can get to a true raw diet without the food-safety risk or freezer space. Excellent for transitioning off ultra-processed kibble.

name: West Paw Hurley Tough Chew Toy
description: Recyclable, BPA-free, latex-free chew toy made in Montana from West Paw's proprietary Zogoflex material. Floats and is dishwasher-safe.
whyRecommended: B-Corp certified, made in the USA, and one of the only toy manufacturers that takes back worn-out toys to recycle into new ones.
editorsNote: Our test dog destroys plush toys in minutes; the Hurley has lasted 18 months and counting. The closed-loop recycling program is a real bonus.

name: Planet Dog Orbee-Tuff Snoop Treat Dispenser
description: Flexible, treat-dispensing puzzle toy made from non-toxic, BPA-free Orbee-Tuff material. A portion of each sale funds service-dog programs.
whyRecommended: Mental enrichment that's safer than hard plastic puzzles. The flexible material means it can be tossed, chewed, and slow-fed without breaking.

name: Wild One Harness
description: Lightweight, padded step-in harness made from recycled, water-resistant materials with a no-pull front clip and reflective trim.
whyRecommended: Designed by a vet-led team, with recycled materials throughout and packaging that's plastic-free. Comfortable enough for all-day wear.
editorsNote: The padded chest plate is genuinely better than most harnesses twice the price. Pairs beautifully with their matching leash.

name: Found My Animal Rope Leash
description: Hand-spliced cotton rope leash made in Brooklyn, NY. A portion of every sale funds shelter and rescue partners.
whyRecommended: Built to last decades, not seasons. Plant-based materials and a clear charitable model that's been running for over a decade.
bestFor: Owners who want one leash for life

name: Earth Rated Compostable Poop Bags
description: USDA-certified plant-based, home-compostable poop bags. Leak-proof, lavender-scented or unscented options.
whyRecommended: One of the only certified-compostable poop bag brands that actually breaks down at home (most 'biodegradable' bags don't).
editorsNote: If you switch one thing for the planet this year, make it your poop bags. Earth Rated also runs a 1% for the Planet membership.

name: Bocce's Bakery Training Treats
description: Limited-ingredient, soft training treats baked in Brooklyn with whole foods like peanut butter, banana, and oatmeal — no preservatives.
whyRecommended: Most training treats are loaded with mystery ingredients. Bocce's keeps the ingredient list to under 10 recognizable items.

name: 4-Legger Organic Hypoallergenic Shampoo
description: USDA-certified organic dog shampoo with aloe and lemongrass. Free of synthetic detergents, parabens, and artificial fragrance.
whyRecommended: Genuinely USDA-certified organic — most 'natural' dog shampoos still contain synthetic surfactants. Safe for sensitive skin.
editorsNote: A go-to for owners of breeds with skin allergies. Rinses out cleanly and doesn't leave residue.

name: Big Barker Orthopedic Dog Bed
description: 10-year warranty orthopedic bed engineered for large and giant breeds. Made in the USA from CertiPUR-US-certified foam that won't flatten.
whyRecommended: Independently studied by the University of Pennsylvania School of Veterinary Medicine and shown to improve joint comfort in large dogs.
editorsNote: The 10-year warranty is unheard of in pet beds. If you have a large-breed dog with hip or joint concerns, this is the bed to buy.

name: Pet Honesty Multivitamin Soft Chews
description: 10-in-1 daily multivitamin chew with glucosamine, omega-3s, probiotics, and antioxidants. NASC-certified facility.
whyRecommended: Made in an NASC-quality-seal facility (the National Animal Supplement Council's gold standard) with no artificial preservatives.
